meta.title: Content Studio
meta.description: Research, write, validate and judge LinkedIn posts with a multi-agent pipeline.

research.name: Research
research.role: Web search, then the research agent picks facts and angles

write.name: Write
write.role: The writer drafts the post, using similar past posts as style memory

validate.name: Validate
validate.role: The validator checks accuracy, tone and clichés

judge.name: Judge
judge.role: An independent judge scores five criteria

memory.name: Memory
memory.role: The finished post is saved for future runs

summary.research: {sources, plural, =0 {No sources} one {# source} other {# sources}} from {queries, plural, one {# search} other {# searches}}

generate.title: Generate
generate.subtitle: Give the agents a topic. They research it, write a post, check it and score it, and you can watch every step.
generate.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Medical AI investment in India
generate.idle: Your run appears here. Each agent's result shows up as soon as it finishes.
generate.recentEmpty: No runs yet. Your first post will show up here.

run.unavailable: Live updates are unavailable. The run may not exist, or the API is down.
run.closed: Live updates stopped. Refresh the page to see the latest state.

result.noFeedback: No feedback was recorded for this run.
result.failureAtStep: The run failed at the {step} step.

issues.RESEARCH_SEARCH_FAILED: A web search failed; research continued with the other results.
issues.RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS_FAILED: The research agent failed, so the writer got the raw search results.
issues.RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS_EMPTY: The research agent returned nothing, so the writer got the raw search results.
issues.WRITER_FAILED: The writer did not return a usable post.
issues.VALIDATOR_FAILED: The validator failed, so the post was not validated.
issues.JUDGE_FAILED: The judge failed, so the post was not scored.
issues.ENQUEUE_FAILED: The run could not be added to the queue.
issues.PIPELINE_ERROR: An unexpected error stopped the run.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Every run, including posts imported from the command-line tool.

detail.inProgress: This run is still in progress.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: How the agents score posts. Averages count successful runs only.
insights.groupDetail: {count, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}} · judge {judge} · validator {validator}
insights.trendSubtitle: Last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, {timeZone} time
insights.trendEmpty: No successful runs in this period.
insights.gapBody: The validator gave {validator} and the judge gave {judge}, a gap of {gap}.
insights.gapNone: No run has both scores yet.
insights.empty: No successful runs yet. Generate a post to see insights.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.subtitle: The prompt files the agents use, read straight from the prompts folder. Edit them in your repository; the worker picks up changes when it restarts.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many posts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE: The job queue is unavailable. Check that Redis and the worker are running.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: A service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server hit an unexpected error.
errors.API_UNREACHABLE: Can't reach the Content Studio API. Check that it is running.
errors.topicField: Enter a topic of up to {max, number} characters.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That page doesn't exist, or the run was removed.
